credential_handling: Exact current key and complete endpoint were compared in memory only; neither value, hash, prefix, nor matching content was persisted.
limits: The active agent-session transcript retains the previously disclosed process-list output and cannot be erased by this filesystem scan.
Remote/provider storage, inaccessible files, other sessions, backups, and Time Machine are outside scan visibility.
decision: Continue use without rotation under the user authorization. Credential transport remains pinned and carries the key in child environment, not process arguments. No provider request or collector activation was performed.
